integrity_notes: A complete mathematical argument and a standalone finite consistency checker are supplied. The finite checker is not a proof of the infinite-parameter assertion. The self-review was performed; independent audit and independent validation were not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only beta bases of lexicographically maximal binary Sturmian words of irrational slope are covered; this does not classify all beta-shifts without typical periodic optimization.
The closure includes rational-jump endpoint bases not themselves Sturmian of irrational rotation number.
Upper box dimension zero is shown locally away from base one; the global upper box dimension at one is not determined.
The normalized gap law assumes rational slopes tend to an irrational limit.
Possible equivalents under older ordered-orbit devil-staircase parameterizations remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Farey-indexed gaps and an exponential gap law for Sturmian beta parameters
